Welcome to Transport Section

Mr. Ibrar Hussain
Director Transport

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Overview
AWKUM has one of the best transport fleet for pick and drop facilities for students and staff at all Campuses in Mardan. This facility is available for all the major and small towns including Peshawar, Charsadda, Nowshera, Risalpur, Swabi, Nawi Kali, Toru, Mayar, Ghari Kapoora, Bakhshali, Gujrat, Gaddar, Sawal Dher, Katlang, Lund Khwar, Mian Khan, Takht Bhai, Fazli Abad, Sher Garh and Manga.
In Shaheed Rashid Hussain Campus Pabbi pick and drop facility is available for Peshawar, Jehangira, Nowshera, Akora Khattak and Mardan.
In Timargara Campus pick and drop facility is available for Timargara, Sarai, Nasafa, Ouch and Gul Abad.
